title: Gridlock
label: Total Package Recordings

type.basis: Evidence specimen; a white-label instrumental with prominent strings.

sound.text: The NTS bio says the production uses 'very noticeable strings'.

context.text: DJ Marsta is a grime DJ and producer from East London; NTS says Gridlock has been played at major events ever since its 2003 release.
NTS lists other Marsta releases, including 'Fibre (Terror Danjah Mix)' (East Iz East / Total Package, 2002) and 'Flames' (A.R.M.Y Bullet, 2004).

calls.label: grime (artist described as a grime DJ and producer)

rels.other: Gridlock (Vocal), B-side of TPC001; vocalist not named

uncertainty: Discogs gives no release date for TPC001; the 2003 date comes from NTS. Credits and the vocalist on the B-side are not listed.
tracklist: A: Gridlock (5:08); B: Gridlock (Vocal) (3:41). Discogs also lists a stickered white-label pressing and a 'Gridlock 4x4' 12" on A.R.M.Y Bullet (BULLET001, UK, 2004).
